exposure: Serum estradiol (E2) levels on the day of human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) administration
cohort: 3393 infertile women undergoing their first fresh in vitro fertilization (IVF) cycle
finding: Elevated serum E2 levels on the day of hCG administration were associated with higher implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth rates after IVF but did not increase the risk of adverse birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly different between women with high and low E2 levels on the day of hCG administration.
